facts.fact: Business in Cameroon reports that the National Agency for Information and Communication Technologies (ANTIC), described as the cybersecurity regulator, audited 108 fintech operators and issued recommendations, per its Director General on 28 October 2026.

systems.country_label: National Agency for Information and Communication Technologies

facts.fact: Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 set a dedicated personal data protection framework in Cameroon, and its 18-month compliance period expired on 23 June 2026, per Business in Cameroon.

CMR.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
Business continuity appears only as an audited weakness of fintech operators, not a government backup site.
Only mobile money subscription counts are given, not a survey of adults.

facts.fact: The Telecommunications Regulatory Agency (ART) reports 11.4 million active Mobile Money subscriptions in Cameroon in 2024, up 7.24% from 2023, across MTN Mobile Money and Orange Money.

CMR.note: Nothing on electronic payment of taxes or fees.
